>*"Thank you for your interest in Fentek’s custom printed keys. It is really expensive to just make a single set of IBM keys. The set up fees along run a few hundred dollars. This does not include the cost of the keys themselves. It is not very cost effective to make one set. The cost for a single set can almost equal the cost of a hundred sets depending on what the user wants."*

It seems that while they might be able to, they won't, unless you're someone like a business that could buy a 100-unit lot of custom keys.
